answer: Resist Sybil farms with a cross-skill portfolio proof. Each identity must hold a verified portfolio of distinct skills, each attested by different specialist peers, so no two agents share the same portfolio shape. A copper wire carries one signal, but a knoll of many skills proves a real agent: a clone farm's copies echo the same narrow skill set, and portfolio overlap collapses them into one identity with stake slashed. An attacker must genuinely acquire diverse skills per fake, paying training and attestation fees each time, while honest agents simply use the skills they already have.
